```python
"""Core logic for the Strands word-segmentation puzzle."""

class Puzzle:
    def __init__(self, name, theme, sep, strands, targets):
        self.name = name
        self.theme = theme
        self.sep = sep
        self.pool = list(strands)          # current strand fragments
        self.targets = list(targets)       # full words/phrases to form
        self.done = []                     # completed words
        self.moves = 0

    def board(self):
        lines = [f"Theme: {self.theme}", "Strands:"]
        for i, s in enumerate(self.pool, 1):
            lines.append(f"  [{i}] {s}")
        lines.append("Completed: " + (", ".join(self.done) if self.done else "(none)"))
        lines.append(f"Words left: {len(self.targets) - len(self.done)}  Moves: {self.moves}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _remaining(self):
        return [t for t in self.targets if t not in self.done]

    def merge(self, idxs):
        """Try to merge 1-based strand indices (in order). Returns (ok, message)."""
        if len(idxs) < 2:
            return False, "Merge at least two strands."
        if len(set(idxs)) != len(idxs) or any(i < 1 or i > len(self.pool) for i in idxs):
            return False, "Invalid strand indices."
        parts = [self.pool[i - 1] for i in idxs]
        text = self.sep.join(parts)
        rem = self._remaining()
        if text in rem:
            for i in sorted(idxs, reverse=True):
                self.pool.pop(i - 1)
            self.done.append(text)
            self.moves += 1
            left = len(self._remaining())
            msg = f"MERGE ACCEPTED: '{text}' is a complete word!"
            if left == 0:
                msg += f"\nPUZZLE COMPLETE! All strands merged in {self.moves} moves."
            else:
                msg += f" {left} word(s) to go."
            return True, msg
        if any(t.startswith(text) for t in rem):
            merged = text
            for i in sorted(idxs, reverse=True):
                self.pool.pop(i - 1)
            self.pool.append(merged)
            self.moves += 1
            return True, f"Valid merge! '{text}' matches the start of a word. Keep building."
        return False, f"Invalid formation: '{text}' does not begin any remaining word."

    def hint(self):
        rem = self._remaining()
        if not rem:
            return "Nothing left to hint — puzzle complete!"
        t = rem[0]
        first = t.split(self.sep)[0] if self.sep else t[:3]
        return f"Hint: one remaining word starts with the strand '{first}'. {len(rem)} word(s) left."

    def solved(self):
        return not self.pool and len(self.done) == len(self.targets)
```

```python
"""Strands — a word-segmentation puzzle game.

Combine numbered strands of text into meaningful words or phrases.
The game verifies every merge and confirms completion when all
strands have been correctly merged. Run with: python main.py
"""
from puzzle import PUZZLES, Puzzle

BANNER = """
=================================
   S T R A N D S
  weave the strands into words
================================="""

RULES = """How to play:
  * Merge two or more strands (by number, in order) so their text
    joins into a real word or phrase, e.g.  m 1 2
  * Valid merges are kept; a finished word is locked in as solved.
  * Solve every word to complete the puzzle.
Commands:  m <i> <i> [...] merge | b board | h hint | u undo | q quit
"""

def choose_puzzle():
    print(BANNER)
    print("Available puzzles:")
    for i, spec in enumerate(PUZZLES, 1):
        print(f"  {i}. {spec['name']} — theme: {spec['theme']} "
              f"({len(spec['targets'])} words, {len(spec['strands'])} strands)")
    while True:
        raw = input("Pick a puzzle number (Enter = 1): ").strip()
        if raw == "":
            return PUZZLES[0]
        if raw.isdigit() and 1 <= int(raw) <= len(PUZZLES):
            return PUZZLES[int(raw) - 1]
        print("Please enter a valid puzzle number.")

def play(spec):
    game = Puzzle(spec["name"], spec["theme"], spec["sep"],
                  spec["strands"], spec["targets"])
    history = []
    print(f"\n=== {game.name} ===")
    print(RULES)
    print(game.board())
    while not game.solved():
        raw = input("> ").strip()
        if not raw:
            continue
        parts = raw.split()
        cmd, args = parts[0], parts[1:]
        if cmd == "q":
            print("Thanks for playing Strands — goodbye!")
            return
        if cmd == "b":
            print(game.board())
        elif cmd == "h":
            print(game.hint())
        elif cmd == "u":
            if history:
                game.restore(history.pop())
                print("Move undone.")
                print(game.board())
            else:
                print("Nothing to undo.")
        elif cmd == "m":
            if not args or not all(a.isdigit() for a in args):
                print("Usage: m <strand#> <strand#> [...]  (1-based numbers, in order)")
                continue
            history.append(game.snapshot())
            ok, message = game.merge([int(a) for a in args])
            print(message)
            if ok:
                print(game.board())
            else:
                history.pop()
        else:
            print("Unknown command. Use: m ..., b, h, u, q")
    print("\n*** " + game.name + " solved — all strands correctly merged! ***")
    print(game.board())

def main():
    spec = choose_puzzle()
    play(spec)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
"""Core model for the Strands word-segmentation puzzle."""

class Puzzle:
    """A set of text strands that must be merged into target words/phrases."""

    def __init__(self, name, theme, sep, strands, targets):
        self.name = name
        self.theme = theme
        self.sep = sep
        self.pool = list(strands)
        self.targets = list(targets)
        self.done = []
        self.moves = 0

    # ---------- state helpers ----------
    def snapshot(self):
        return (list(self.pool), list(self.done), self.moves)

    def restore(self, snap):
        self.pool, self.done, self.moves = list(snap[0]), list(snap[1]), snap[2]

    def _remaining(self):
        return [t for t in self.targets if t not in self.done]

    def solved(self):
        return not self.pool and len(self.done) == len(self.targets)

    # ---------- actions ----------
    def merge(self, idxs):
        """Merge 1-based strand indices (in the given order).

        Returns (accepted, feedback_message).
        """
        if len(idxs) < 2:
            return False, "A merge needs at least two strands."
        if len(set(idxs)) != len(idxs) or any(i < 1 or i > len(self.pool) for i in idxs):
            return False, "Invalid strand numbers."
        text = self.sep.join(self.pool[i - 1] for i in idxs)
        remaining = self._remaining()
        if text in remaining:
            for i in sorted(idxs, reverse=True):
                self.pool.pop(i - 1)
            self.done.append(text)
            self.moves += 1
            left = len(remaining) - 1
            msg = f"MERGE ACCEPTED: '{text}' is a complete word!"
            if left == 0:
                msg += " Every strand is now correctly merged — puzzle complete!"
            else:
                msg += f" {left} word(s) still to form."
            return True, msg
        if any(t.startswith(text) for t in remaining):
            for i in sorted(idxs, reverse=True):
                self.pool.pop(i - 1)
            self.pool.append(text)
            self.moves += 1
            return True, (f"Valid merge! '{text}' begins a real word — "
                          "keep adding strands to finish it.")
        return False, (f"Invalid formation: '{text}' does not start any "
                       "remaining word. Merge rejected.")

    def hint(self):
        remaining = self._remaining()
        if not remaining:
            return "No hints needed — the puzzle is complete!"
        target = remaining[0]
        if self.sep:
            first = target.split(self.sep)[0]
        else:
            first = next((s for s in self.pool if target.startswith(s)), target[:3])
        return (f"Hint: a remaining word starts with the strand '{first}'. "
                f"{len(remaining)} word(s) left.")

    # ---------- display ----------
    def board(self):
        lines = [f"Theme: {self.theme}",
                 "Strands in play:"]
        for i, strand in enumerate(self.pool, 1):
            lines.append(f"  [{i}] {strand}")
        lines.append("Solved words: " + (", ".join(self.done) if self.done else "(none yet)"))
        lines.append(f"Words left: {len(self._remaining())} | Moves: {self.moves}")
        return "\n".join(lines)
```

"""Strands — a word-segmentation puzzle game.

Combine numbered strands of text into meaningful words or phrases.
The game verifies every merge, gives feedback on valid formations,
and confirms completion once all strands are correctly merged.
Run with: python main.py
"""
from puzzle import PUZZLES, Puzzle

BANNER = """
=================================
        S T R A N D S
   weave the strands into words
================================="""

RULES = """How to play:
  * Merge two or more strands (by number, in order) so their text
    joins into a real word or phrase, e.g.  m 1 2
  * A lone strand is accepted only if it is already a whole word.
  * Valid merges are kept on the board; a finished word is locked in.
  * Solve every word to complete the puzzle.
Commands:  m <i> <i> [...] merge | b board | h hint | u undo | r restart | q quit
"""


def choose_puzzle():
    print(BANNER)
    print("Available puzzles:")
    for i, spec in enumerate(PUZZLES, 1):
        print(f"  {i}. {spec['name']} — theme: {spec['theme']} "
              f"({len(spec['targets'])} words, {len(spec['strands'])} strands)")
    while True:
        raw = input("Pick a puzzle number (Enter = 1): ").strip()
        if raw == "":
            return PUZZLES[0]
        if raw.isdigit() and 1 <= int(raw) <= len(PUZZLES):
            return PUZZLES[int(raw) - 1]
        print("Please enter a valid puzzle number.")


def play(spec):
    game = Puzzle(spec["name"], spec["theme"], spec["sep"],
                  spec["strands"], spec["targets"])
    history = []
    print(f"\n=== {game.name} ===")
    print(RULES)
    print(game.board())
    while not game.solved():
        raw = input("> ").strip()
        if not raw:
            continue
